summary: The victim purchased a fraudulent SPCX token promoted during heightened SpaceX attention and exchanged legitimate assets through a wallet only to receive nearly worthless tokens. The scheme exploited hype around a nonexistent token offering tied to a well-known brand.
user_mistake: Purchased an unverified token driven by hype and fear of missing out
prevention: Confirm official token existence through issuer channels/Check contract authenticity before swapping assets
